theorem bbolt.Bucket.spill.wp_proof [hos : HasExt osFsExt] (hNS : bbolt.Spill.node.spill.spec')
    (hRoot : bbolt.node.root.spec) (hPgid : bbolt.internal.common.Meta.Pgid.spec) (hSRP :
    bbolt.internal.common.InBucket.SetRootPage.spec) (hInl : bbolt.Bucket.inlineable.spec) (hCur :
    bbolt.Bucket.Cursor_i.spec) (hSeek : bbolt.Cursor.seek_w.spec) (hNode : bbolt.Cursor.node.spec)
    (hPut : bbolt.node.put.spec) (hEq : bytes.Equal.spec) (hFree : bbolt.Bucket.free.spec) (hWrite :
    bbolt.Bucket.write.spec) : bbolt.Bucket.spill.spec
  -- `Perennial.EtcdGrove.bbolt.Bucket.spill.spec`, unfolded:
  ∀ (K : bbolt.BC) (tx : Loc) (r : bbolt.TxReg) (m : Bool) (X : bbolt.WX) (w : bbolt.WDb) (P : IProp GF),
    bbolt.spillPre X w.fl →
      bbolt.liveReach X →
        BitVec.toNat X.t.mv.pgid' * 4096 ≤ bbolt.mapLen w.ms →
          bbolt.flViewU X w.fl →
            bbolt.spillStartOK X w →
              BitVec.toNat X.t.mv.txid' < 2 ^ 63 →
                bbolt.markCov X w.C.hwm →
                  ⊢
                    ∀ Φ,
                      bbolt.wtxW K tx r m X ∗ bbolt.wdbW K tx X.v w ∗ bbolt.poolR K.B.bq K.N P -∗
                        (▷
                            ∀ err,
                              bbolt.poolR K.B.bq K.N P ∗
                                  ((⌜err = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗
                                      ∃ X' w',
                                        bbolt.wtxW K tx r m X' ∗
                                          bbolt.wdbW K tx X'.v w' ∗
                                            ⌜bbolt.spillOK X X' w.C w.fl w'.fl w.wtxid ∧
                                                w'.C = w.C ∧
                                                  bbolt.derefPre X' ∧
                                                    bbolt.liveFresh X' ∧
                                                      bbolt.liveReach X' ∧
                                                        BitVec.toNat X'.t.mv.pgid' * 4096 ≤ bbolt.mapLen w'.ms ∧
                                                          bbolt.spillBufs X' w.C w'.fl ∧
                                                            X'.t.t = X.t.t ∧
                                                              X'.rl = X.rl ∧
                                                                (X'.t.bs !! X'.rl).isSome = true ∧
                                                                  (X'.t.mv =
                                                                      have __src := X.t.mv;
                                                                      { magic' := __src.magic',
                                                                        version' := __src.version',
                                                                        pageSize' := __src.pageSize',
                                                                        flags' := __src.flags', root' := __src.root',
                                                                        freelist' := __src.freelist',
                                                                        pgid' := X'.t.mv.pgid', txid' := __src.txid',
                                                                        checksum' := __src.checksum' }) ∧
                                                                    (∀ (s : Nat),
                                                                        s ∈ bbolt.treeSlots (bbolt.spillC X' w.C.pages) →
                                                                          ¬s ∈ bbolt.pendSlots w'.fl) ∧
                                                                      bbolt.markCov X' w.C.hwm ∧
                                                                        (∀ (s : Nat),
                                                                            s ∈ bbolt.bufSlots X'.t.bufs →
                                                                              W64 ↑s ∈ w.fl.free ∨ w.C.hwm ≤ s) ∧
                                                                          ∀ (s : Nat),
                                                                            s ∈ w.W →
                                                                              ¬s ∈ bbolt.pendSlots w'.fl →
                                                                                w'.wb s = w.wb s⌝) ∨
                                    ⌜err ≠ GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗
                                      fmtErrorOk err ∗
                                        ∃ X' w' st,
                                          ⌜w'.C = w.C ∧
                                                w'.fl = w.fl.applySteps w.wtxid st ∧
                                                  X'.v.pages = X.v.pages ∧
                                                    X'.t.t = X.t.t ∧
                                                      X'.rl = X.rl ∧
                                                        (X'.t.bs !! X'.rl).isSome = true ∧
                                                          X'.t.mv =
                                                            have __src := X.t.mv;
                                                            { magic' := __src.magic', version' := __src.version',
                                                              pageSize' := __src.pageSize', flags' := __src.flags',
                                                              root' := __src.root', freelist' := __src.freelist',
                                                              pgid' := X'.t.mv.pgid', txid' := __src.txid',
                                                              checksum' := __src.checksum' }⌝ ∗
                                            (bbolt.wtxW K tx r m X' ∗ bbolt.wdbW K tx X'.v w' ∨
                                              bbolt.wtxLost K tx r m X' ∗ bbolt.wdbLost K tx X'.v w')) -∗
                                Φ (intoVal err)) -∗
                          WP
                            ((intoVal
                                (methods go_etcd_io.bbolt.Bucket.ty.PointerType go!"spill"
                                  (intoVal (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.bbolt.Tx go!"root" tx))))
                              (intoVal ()))
                            {{ Φ }}

theorem bbolt.Spill.errFacts_of_spErr [hos : HasExt osFsExt] {X X' : bbolt.WX} {w w' : bbolt.WDb}
    {st : List bbolt.FLStep} (h : bbolt.Spill.spErr X X' w w' st) (hr : (X.t.bs !! X.rl).isSome =
    true) : w'.C = w.C ∧ w'.fl = w.fl.applySteps w.wtxid st ∧ X'.v.pages = X.v.pages ∧ X'.t.t =
    X.t.t ∧ X'.rl = X.rl ∧ (X'.t.bs !! X'.rl).isSome = true ∧ X'.t.mv = have __src := X.t.mv; {
    magic' := __src.magic', version' := __src.version', pageSize' := __src.pageSize', flags' :=
    __src.flags', root' := __src.root', freelist' := __src.freelist', pgid' := X'.t.mv.pgid', txid'
    := __src.txid', checksum' := __src.checksum' }

def bbolt.Spill.spillPost [hos : HasExt osFsExt] (K : bbolt.BC) (tx : Loc) (r : bbolt.TxReg) (m :
    Bool) (X : bbolt.WX) (w : bbolt.WDb) (err : GoInterface) : IProp GF :=
  iprop((⌜err = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗
        ∃ X' w',
          bbolt.wtxW K tx r m X' ∗
            bbolt.wdbW K tx X'.v w' ∗
              ⌜bbolt.spillOK X X' w.C w.fl w'.fl w.wtxid ∧
                  w'.C = w.C ∧
                    bbolt.derefPre X' ∧
                      bbolt.liveFresh X' ∧
                        bbolt.liveReach X' ∧
                          BitVec.toNat X'.t.mv.pgid' * 4096 ≤ bbolt.mapLen w'.ms ∧
                            bbolt.spillBufs X' w.C w'.fl ∧
                              X'.t.t = X.t.t ∧
                                X'.rl = X.rl ∧
                                  (X'.t.bs !! X'.rl).isSome = true ∧
                                    (X'.t.mv =
                                        have __src := X.t.mv;
                                        { magic' := __src.magic', version' := __src.version',
                                          pageSize' := __src.pageSize', flags' := __src.flags', root' := __src.root',
                                          freelist' := __src.freelist', pgid' := X'.t.mv.pgid', txid' := __src.txid',
                                          checksum' := __src.checksum' }) ∧
                                      (∀ (s : Nat),
                                          s ∈ bbolt.treeSlots (bbolt.spillC X' w.C.pages) → ¬s ∈ bbolt.pendSlots w'.fl) ∧
                                        bbolt.markCov X' w.C.hwm ∧
                                          (∀ (s : Nat), s ∈ bbolt.bufSlots X'.t.bufs → W64 ↑s ∈ w.fl.free ∨ w.C.hwm ≤ s) ∧
                                            ∀ (s : Nat), s ∈ w.W → ¬s ∈ bbolt.pendSlots w'.fl → w'.wb s = w.wb s⌝) ∨
      ⌜err ≠ GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗
        fmtErrorOk err ∗
          ∃ X' w' st,
            ⌜w'.C = w.C ∧
                  w'.fl = w.fl.applySteps w.wtxid st ∧
                    X'.v.pages = X.v.pages ∧
                      X'.t.t = X.t.t ∧
                        X'.rl = X.rl ∧
                          (X'.t.bs !! X'.rl).isSome = true ∧
                            X'.t.mv =
                              have __src := X.t.mv;
                              { magic' := __src.magic', version' := __src.version', pageSize' := __src.pageSize',
                                flags' := __src.flags', root' := __src.root', freelist' := __src.freelist',
                                pgid' := X'.t.mv.pgid', txid' := __src.txid', checksum' := __src.checksum' }⌝ ∗
              (bbolt.wtxW K tx r m X' ∗ bbolt.wdbW K tx X'.v w' ∨ bbolt.wtxLost K tx r m X' ∗ bbolt.wdbLost K tx X'.v w'))

theorem bbolt.Cursor.seek_w.spec.congr_simp [hos : HasExt osFsExt] : bbolt.Cursor.seek_w.spec =
    bbolt.Cursor.seek_w.spec

def bbolt.Spill.loopP [hos : HasExt osFsExt] (K : bbolt.BC) (tx : Loc) (r : bbolt.TxReg) (m : Bool)
    (X : bbolt.WX) (w : bbolt.WDb) (B0 : bbolt.BRec) (P : IProp GF) (Φ : val → IProp GF) (res bp cp
    np : Loc) (keys : List GoString) (i : Nat) (m' : GMap GoString Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜m' = B0.bm⌝ ∗
      (∀ err, bbolt.poolR K.B.bq K.N P -∗ bbolt.Spill.spillPost K tx r m X w err -∗ Φ (intoVal err)) ∗
        bbolt.poolR K.B.bq K.N P ∗
          typedPointsto res GoInterface.nil (DFrac.own 1) ∗
            typedPointsto bp X.rl (DFrac.own 1) ∗
              (∃ cv, typedPointsto cp cv (DFrac.own 1)) ∗
                (∃ nv, typedPointsto np nv (DFrac.own 1)) ∗
                  ∃ X' w' st Lroot Dc ks,
                    (ownMap B0.bv.buckets' (DFrac.own 1) B0.bm -∗ bbolt.wtxW K tx r m X') ∗
                      bbolt.wdbW K tx X'.v w' ∗
                        ⌜bbolt.Spill.RInv X w B0 keys Lroot X' w' st Dc ks ∧ bbolt.Spill.ksAt keys i ks⌝)

theorem bbolt.Spill.spillPost.congr_simp [hos : HasExt osFsExt] (K K✝ : bbolt.BC) (e_K : K = K✝) (tx
    tx✝ : Loc) (e_tx : tx = tx✝) (r r✝ : bbolt.TxReg) (e_r : r = r✝) (m m✝ : Bool) (e_m : m = m✝) (X
    X✝ : bbolt.WX) (e_X : X = X✝) (w w✝ : bbolt.WDb) (e_w : w = w✝) (err err✝ : GoInterface) (e_err
    : err = err✝) : bbolt.Spill.spillPost K tx r m X w err = bbolt.Spill.spillPost K✝ tx✝ r✝ m✝ X✝
    w✝ err✝
